shortBio.en: Blackmore / Dio hard rock; bridge from Purple to Sabbath’s Dio era.
shortBio.zh: Blackmore / Dio 的 hard rock；从 Purple 到 Sabbath Dio 时期的桥。

body.en:
Formed 1975. Ritchie Blackmore’s Rainbow through Long Live Rock ’n’ Roll pair Blackmore’s neoclassical leads with Ronnie James Dio’s operatic mid-range and Cozy Powell’s drums on key records.

Person-graph bridge: Dio arrives battle-tested before Black Sabbath’s Heaven and Hell. Later Graham Bonnet/Joe Lynn Turner lineups are separate commercial chapters.
body.zh:
1975 年组建。从 Ritchie Blackmore’s Rainbow 到 Long Live Rock ’n’ Roll：Blackmore 新古典主音对 Ronnie James Dio 歌剧式中音区，关键唱片含 Cozy Powell 鼓。

人物图谱桥：Dio 在加入 Black Sabbath 的 Heaven and Hell 前已在此练兵。后期 Graham Bonnet/Joe Lynn Turner 阵容是另一商业章节。

whyMatters.en: Ritchie Blackmore’s post–Deep Purple band; Rising (1976) and the Dio years set fantasy-lyric hard rock with classical guitar figures.
whyMatters.zh: Ritchie Blackmore 离开 Deep Purple 后的乐队；Rising（1976）与 Dio 时期定下奇幻歌词 hard rock 与古典吉他音型。
